description: Windows 11 update monitor that checks pending updates against Microsoft's known issues and pauses affected updates.
notes: Uses the official Windows x64 ZIP. It is intended for Windows 11; the setup installer is not run by Scoop.

The ZIP does not register the hourly SYSTEM scheduled task configured by PatchLight-Setup.exe. Automatic hourly checks and automatic pausing therefore are not configured by this manifest; the task requires administrator rights. Use the official installer if you need that full background-protection setup.
The upstream releases are not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may display a warning.
